title: BasilBot localization catalog
description: Defines the structure and text values for this localization catalog.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema for this catalog.

WhereUsage.description: Usage message shown when !where is missing a player name.

NotRegistered.description: Reply when !where cannot find an account. {0} is the requested player name.

WhereIsIn.description: Reports the registered player's country. {0} is the player name and {1} is the country.

FaqUsage.description: Usage message shown when !faq has no entry name or list argument.

NoFaqEntryFound.description: Reply when the requested FAQ entry is unavailable. {0} is the requested entry name.

NoFaqEntriesAvailable.description: Reply when !faq list has no entries to show.

AvailableFaqEntries.description: Lists the available FAQ entry names. {0} is the formatted list.

RollResult.description: Shows the result of !roll. {0} is the player name and {1} is the rolled number.

General.description: Replies for BasilBot commands outside multiplayer management.
